info.name: Qiskit Runtime Jobs API
info.description:
Submit, list, inspect, cancel, delete, and tag Qiskit Runtime quantum primitive jobs (Sampler and Estimator) executed on IBM Quantum hardware. Retrieve job results, logs, metrics and manage job tags.

Contact Support:
 Name: IBM Quantum
